I approved PR #4 and moved its label from `ai:changes-requested` to `ai:approved`. I posted an approval comment that explains why.

I read the diff and the four screenshots, but I didn't run `npm run validate` or the scroll-spy itself. The screenshots are full-page captures, so they don't show the highlighted nav link.

- **Scope:** The PR covers issue #3 only: a scroll-spy in `site/app.js`, a CSS rule in `site/style.css`, and a build-log entry. It touches no guardrail files, workflows, secrets or dependencies.
